about: The joins the project checks. type 'join': a (and b) are mesh names in the built scene; mode intersect = a passes into b (the join is the crease where they meet), boundary = a's open edge meets b's, seam = one mesh cut along seam_plane (origin, normal) within clip. type 'profile': a line cut by plane, kept within clip and the polar fan (cy,cz,a0,a1 in the y-z plane), with joins_at naming where a join lies on it (cm from the low end, or kmax:AXIS:LO:HI). Add a join here when its figure is built and its mesh names are checked with tools/joins/dump.py.

neck.note: the mannequin's head where it passes into the body's neck (the visible neck is the body's; the rig's Neck object lies inside it)

foot-top.note: the right foot's top line through its middle, toe tip to the shin, as the foot study takes it (x0 -2.8, centre (y,z) = (-2,1), -5..100 deg); the join is the ankle's front, where the shin meets the instep
